profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer & Web Applications Developer
profile.summary: I am an energetic Software Engineering & Web Developer with diverse experience in fast-paced technical environments. I thrive in spaces where I can collaborate across teams and project areas to advance individual project and development elements. Throughout my career thus far, I have gained expertise in solutions design, software engineering, integration testing code, unit testing, database management, and other key areas.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
I currently support a broad range of software engineering activities for a leading U.S. defense contractor. In this role, I developed Java code and used Liquibase database scripts to parse PDFs for military customers into readable Microsoft Excel spreadsheets. I also modified data, authored queries, and developed Java Code. I served on a team that won a company award for generating an $8M cost savings over five years by reducing time to analyze, parse, assign, and modify government contracts.

I also recently completed a Six Sigma project that resulted in the development of a new web page for a company video tutorial tool in JavaScript and HTML, and I routinely leverage Six Sigma concepts to drive ongoing improvements across existing projects.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description: I was promoted to this role to resolve a host of issues resulting from code bugs and defects to continually improve company performance and minimize monetary loss. I tested software to ensure ongoing maintenance across new and existing products, created and integrated functional REST web services for the common global services team, and played an integral role in supporting the daily functions of an Agile team, including leveraging various Agile methodologies to advance key activities.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: I was selected to an internship to develop scripting files in Unix shell scripting file language, create test cases to aid in regression testing, and support teams in conducting code reviews and developing C++ code. Following a strong performance, I was promoted to a full-time Software Developer II role.
